uutiset.t: Senegal reinstated as Afcon 2025 winners - 10 months after tournament
uutiset.s: Ten months after the 2025 Africa Cup of Nations final, Senegal are reinstated as champions following a ruling by the Court of Arbitration for Sport.

uutiset.t: Sooryavanshi, 15, breaks sixes record by scoring 204 off 53 balls
uutiset.s: India's 15-year-old sensation Vaibhav Sooryavanshi blazes 204 from 53 balls for India A, almost halving the record for the fastest double-century in List A cricket.

uutiset.t: Millwall face partial stadium closure over chants
uutiset.s: Millwall must play a home game in front of a partially-closed stadium as punishment for fans' discriminatory chants.

uutiset.t: Commanders claim late win to come back against Bengals
uutiset.s: Drew Stevens kicks a last-second field goal to see Washington Commanders come back against the Cincinnati Bengals in a close match.

uutiset.t: Gloucestershire renamed Bristol Lions for T20 Blast
uutiset.s: Gloucestershire will rebrand to Bristol Lions for the T20 Blast from the 2027 season.

uutiset.t: Women's smaller ball trial extended into second season
uutiset.s: World Rugby extends the women's 4.5 ball trial for a second season after releasing data showing improvements in several areas of the game and receiving "overwhelmingly positive" feedback from players and coaches.

uutiset.t: England seamer Robinson joins Notts from Sussex
uutiset.s: England seamer Ollie Robinson leaves Sussex after 11 years to join Nottinghamshire for an undisclosed "compensation package" on a three-year deal.

uutiset.t: 'The rest of the world noticed' - Welshman Donald demolishes Aussies
uutiset.s: A remarkable opening partnership of 150 in 10 overs between Aneurin Donald and Phil Salt helps England chase 184 against Australia to level the T20 series.

uutiset.t: Non-league player injured falling down badger hole
uutiset.s: Cav Miley missed Chelmsford City's draw with Walton and Hersham after spraining an ankle falling down a badger hole.

uutiset.t: Palace docked points for using four sub windows in WSL win
uutiset.s: Crystal Palace say they are "disappointed" by the ruling which they "do not agree is reasonable or proportionate".

uutiset.t: Glens boss Ferguson apologises after seven-game ban
uutiset.s: Glentoran manager Duncan Ferguson will be suspended for seven games following his red card in the side's 3-2 defeat by Cliftonville last week.

uutiset.t: Coventry & Worcester express Prem interest on own terms
uutiset.s: Champ clubs Coventry and Warriors confirm interest in Prem places - but not if it puts their clubs at financial risk.

uutiset.t: 49ers win in Mexico and Bills stay top - NFL week 11
uutiset.s: The San Francisco 49ers and Buffalo Bills remain the pacesetters in each conference of the NFL.

uutiset.t: Dead hippo to be honoured on football club tifo
uutiset.s: Major League Soccer side FC Cincinnati will honour Fiona, a hippo that recently died at the city's zoo, with a tifo display at their match with Nashville SC on Saturday.
